description: REALIZABLE_EA rejects all quotes before processing and uses the first quote at or after eligibility.
Delay 0 still requires a real quote strictly after the signal tick.
Delay 100 ms accepts equality and rejects boundary minus one.
Delay 250 ms accepts equality and rejects boundary minus one.
Submit latency is added to processing and can dominate requested delay.
If no tick exists at eligibility the first later real tick is used.
A stale grid quote can detect but cannot fill Detection delay 0 at the boundary.
A watermark-released old signal cannot use a quote earlier than its 1600 ms processing time.
Failed-shock reversal signal remains the invalidation tick and entry uses a later tick.
250 500 and 1000 ms log returns use independent exact anchors.
Missing exact anchor yields invalid and blank output rather than zero.
Type-7 linear percentile on half-tick bins is independently defined.
Robust Z uses median and 1.4826 times MAD.
MAD zero uses the configured price noise floor and remains finite.
Efficiency is net displacement divided by absolute path length.
Zero path denominator rejects the shock.
Tick intensity threshold is inclusive at 1.5.
Move over spread threshold is inclusive at 4.0.
Spread ratio ceiling is inclusive at 1.5.
All six detector gates define before equal and after behavior without market fitting.
299 valid samples are insufficient when the minimum is 300.
Exactly 300 valid samples make baseline evaluation eligible.
Long burst to valid pullback to two-tick reacceleration reaches a continuation signal.
Short path mirrors Long through burst pullback and reacceleration.
Burst quiet threshold freezes at exactly 300 ms since last extreme.
Burst maximum freezes at exactly 3000 ms even if quiet timeout is disabled.
Retracement below 15 percent remains WAIT_PULLBACK.
Retracement lower and upper bounds 15 and 35 percent are valid and inclusive.
Retracement just above 35 but below 50 is diagnostic too-deep and not a valid pullback.
Retracement exactly 50 percent invalidates continuation at that tick.
Pullback wait times out at exactly 10000 ms from burst end.
Valid pullback without two breakout confirmations expires at the same wait boundary.
Long spread stress widens only Bid Ask while risk stays based on unstressed spread.
Short spread stress and adverse entry rounding mirror Long with fixed absolute risk.
Outward target rounding never reduces requested 1.2R.
A price gap through TP fills at the TP barrier like a limit.
Long stop gaps use first Bid beyond SL plus adverse exit slippage.
Short stop gaps use first Ask beyond SL plus adverse exit slippage.
Hard time exit occurs at equality and uses current tradable Bid.
Commission R is round-turn commission divided by one-lot SL loss and reduces net R once.
StopsLevel is checked from current Bid for Long and current Ask for Short.
Cost and range policy gates are a two-bit label and never erase broker-feasible outcomes.
Same-symbol same-millisecond group closes the grid with its final quote.
Simultaneous currencies preserve deterministic time symbol sequence order.
Slow currency holds active currency until frontier advances and delay is processing latency.
Cross-symbol market cluster uses first-event anchor with inclusive 2000 ms boundary.
Different detectors for one shock produce separate event rows but one market cluster.
Exact same symbol detector and detection time is emitted once.
A second run with the same RunId must not silently append into the first run files.
Reparsed scenario cells exactly match summary valid invalid and R totals.
Evidence is eligible only when source config terminal broker and chart provenance match.
One entry deal fills requested volume and advances only after resolution.
Multiple entry deals are volume-weighted and all included.
Partial fill remains entry-pending until all entry deals are aggregated.
Residual cancel resolves entry after retaining filled volume and zeroing remaining active quantity.
Long server SL observation requires a real tester deal reason SL.
Short server SL observation requires a real tester deal reason SL.
Long server TP observation requires a real tester deal reason TP.
Short server TP observation requires a real tester deal reason TP.
Long expert time close aggregates its exit deal and labels client/expert reason separately from server barriers.
Short expert time close mirrors Long and aggregates the exit deal.
Managed position recovery restores identity direction volume time SL and TP.
A restart that was not injected is SKIP NOT_OBSERVED and never increments PASS.
Injected two-phase restart restores an owned live position then continues management.
Reject min efficiency greater than one.
Reject negative entry and exit slippage.
Reject negative configured commission.
Reject pullback and continuation percentages outside zero through one hundred.
Reject invalid execution mode NaN and Infinity.
Production OnInit invokes full TSConfigValid and returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT for invalid input.
Configured nonzero commission fails closed when one-lot loss calculation fails.
Commission is deducted from gross R exactly once.
Commission result retains symbol source and one-lot stop loss.
Default fresh rerun rejects an existing identical RunId and fingerprint.
Resume requires explicit flag checkpoint and cursor.
Identity includes period model broker build commit EX5 schema and config.
Reject a concurrent writer to the same CSV.
Event pool exhaustion has a distinct status.
Pending capacity failure is observable and counted as dropped data.
Any capacity hit makes the validation run invalid.
Same-millisecond CopyTicks page saturation advances or fails closed without an infinite refetch.
Target construction failure is not serialized as invalid broker target.
Invalid risk direction and tick size have distinct status.
Direction zero serializes as NONE or INVALID and never SHORT.
Duplicate deal ticket notification is idempotent.
Reject deal whose request order symbol or Magic does not match.
Entry and exit deal aggregates remain separate.
Restart snapshot replay is idempotent.
Stale-symbol pending growth is observable without changing release semantics.
Incomplete frontier or capacity evidence invalidates the formal run.
